pr_title: fix race on integration test for portforward
pr_body:
Fixes: #125904 

```release-note
NONE
```

The race happens because the test reads the buffer used to store the `stdout` that is also used by the streams .

Making the buffer thread safe removes the race

```
o test -timeout 30s -run ^TestPortforward$ k8s.io/kubernetes/test/integration/apiserver/portforward  -count 1 -race
ok      k8s.io/kubernetes/test/integration/apiserver/portforward        8.784s
```

submited a PR for this one, is a matter of making the buffer thread safe https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/125908

review_comments:
There are quite a few other tests which use `NewTestIOStreams`. That method is marked "deprecated" with itself (?!) as replacement. I haven't looked into the history.

Would it perhaps make sense to fix that method so that it returns thread-safe streams?

Otherwise we might have to adapt the other tests at some future time....
I also got confused for a moment, looks like there are two similarly named packages that expose `NewTestIOStreams`, `genericiooptions` and `genericclioptions`.

> Would it perhaps make sense to fix that method so that it returns thread-safe streams?

IIRC the streams are not safe because they are used on tests and the buffers are shared, same as the test on the apiserver that need to do deepcopy on the vars
